asks: Which agent programs run in a computer?
answer: Any agent program runs in a computer, unmodified, including one Silo does not offer to install: you install it the vendor's way, as on any machine. Silo never modifies an agent program, Claude Code included, whether or not Anthropic's rule for a product that preinstalls or runs Claude Code applies to Silo. Silo records what it does from outside, as for any program. Silo has no data file for such a program, so what needs one is not done for it. Its login may be copied into a fork, and Silo says so before the fork is made. Whether its conversation is taken up again in a fork is not checked.
